chunks: And Zurarah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:

“Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, made salat (prayer) obligatory, and the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله established ten forms: the salat of travel, the salat of residence, the salat of fear in three forms, the salat for the eclipse of the sun and the moon, the salat of the two Eids, the salat of seeking rain, and the salat over the deceased.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ: the funeral prayer over the deceased
key_terms.صَلَاةَ الْخَوْفِ: the salat performed in situations of fear or danger
key_terms.صَلَاةَ كُسُوفِ الشَّمْسِ وَ الْقَمَرِ: the salat for solar and lunar eclipse
key_terms.فَرَضَ: made obligatory as a divine duty

ai.seo_question: What forms of salat (prayer) were established by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah made salat (prayer) obligatory, while the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله established its practical forms and categories. It highlights several legally recognized forms of salat, including travel prayer, resident prayer, fear prayer, eclipse prayer, Eid prayer, rain prayer, and funeral prayer.
